data.title: 法琳 · 秘境温泉中的水汽与羽翼微拂
data.description: 在迷宫深处无人涉足的天然地热温泉里，岩石周围长满了发光的奇异苔藓。法琳浸润在温暖滚烫的泉水之中，纯净的泉水洗去所有疲惫，白皙的肩颈与锁骨泛着健康的红晕。水汽蒸腾间，她轻轻拢起湿漉漉的短金发，眼神圣洁而深情地注视着眼前之人。
data.action: 浸润在温暖滚烫的泉水之中，纯净的泉水洗去所有疲惫
data.lighting: ethereal soft glow of bioluminescent moss and warm steam
data.promptProse: Inside a quiet cavern geothermal pool lit by faintly glowing moss on the wet rocks, Falin rests in the steaming water and gathers her wet hair back with one hand. Soft bioluminescent reflections shimmer across the ripples as she meets the viewer's eyes.
data.animaCaption: Soaking nude up to her collarbone in the steaming underground hot spring ringed by glowing moss, she lifts her damp hair from her neck and looks warmly at the viewer with flushed cheeks.
data.nsfwProse: Unclothed in the clear hot spring with water reaching her chest, her bare shoulders, wet collarbone, and upper cleavage glisten with steam and water droplets.
